historical_clean_machine_replay.rationale: The project owner accepted deferring the independent clean-machine historical image replay until after the initial stable release.
residual_risks: Machine-specific packaging or inference regressions may remain undiscovered.
The completed development-machine replay does not prove behavior on an independent clean Windows installation.

authenticode_code_signing.rationale: The project owner accepted publishing v1.0.0 without an Authenticode certificate.
residual_risks: Windows SmartScreen may warn users or impede installation.
Users must verify the published SHA-256 checksum because Windows cannot establish publisher identity.
